spec.body_markdown: ## Vector Components\n\nAny vector can be resolved into perpendicular components. If R makes angle theta with the x-axis, Vx = R cos(theta) and Vy = R sin(theta). Components turn vector geometry into simple algebra: to add vectors, just add their matching components.
